findings.title: Known present diagnostics still prevent canonical target delivery
findings.description: projection_is_canonical requires projection.diagnostics.is_empty(). CodexEventAdapter deliberately emits token_usage_record and developer_message_hidden as static Diagnostic events with Availability::Present; is_diagnostic only treats ParseGap/UnknownEvent as incomplete, so adapt_records accepts these records. AnalysisReducer retains their informational diagnostics. The target's post-reduction guard at238 then downgrades a canonical candidate to partial, drops its ForwardAppend cursor, and removes formal append state. Thus the parse fix does not achieve the accepted completed+canonical target goal even for a physically complete known source.
evidence: Current recorded formal EXE SHA a40feca...:2-record stable synthetic baseline returns completed/canonical with source_end519.
The same baseline plus one valid known token_usage_record returns partial; source_range0..1266 covers all bytes, batch.diagnostics empty, projection has one present token_usage_record diagnostic.
The same baseline plus one valid developer message returns partial; source_range0..810 covers all bytes, batch.diagnostics empty, projection has one present developer_message_hidden diagnostic.

Unchanged real source SHA0deda040... has227 records/1303231 bytes. Current target returns partial after one positive test-peer ACK; batch.diagnostics empty, projection availability present,129 diagnostics all present, including21 token_usage_record and3 developer_message_hidden; no unknown_event/parse_gap diagnostic remains.
findings.impact: Canonical Rust handoff and the original Task005 publication blocker remain unresolved. The CR line34 attributes partial to lack of a source boundary and line57 proposes another source, but the synthetic controls show a deterministic target compatibility/predicate problem that changing sources alone will not solve.
findings.requested_change: Within an explicitly locked minimal Rust scope, distinguish recognized informational compatibility diagnostics from incomplete/unknown evidence in the target projection path. Preserve unknown/malformed/source/lineage fail-closed behavior and hidden content/usage isolation; do not broadly disable completeness gates. Add meaningful target-process regression for both known carriers and retain true negative controls. Correct the partial diagnosis and rerun fixed-source canonical/ACK checks when the implementation actually changes.
